title: Cost of the zero-dimensional sparse-spectrum learner
statement: For any natural number $n$ and Boolean target on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, the learner that queries the target once at the all-one input and returns the constant sparse Fourier hypothesis with that value has output equal to that hypothesis and cost $(0,1,1)$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean target function on the n-dimensional sign cube
